organization.name_en: Kumon Institute of Education Co., Ltd.

affected.note: Ranked by the largest single figure published (739,714) because no overall total was given. 739,714 members (deduplicated by Kumon) + 17,481 instructors; Kumon does not state a combined total (Security NEXT: ~76万). First report (2024-07-05) identified 4,678 members with address/phone/iKUMON codes.

summary.en: Kumon Institute of Education said data it had given printing contractor ISETO leaked after ransomware hit ISETO. After ISETO's final report, Kumon found that data of 739,714 members, such as names, member numbers and classroom names, and 17,481 instructors, including addresses and masked bank details, had leaked.
summary.ja: 公文教育研究会は、発送物の印刷などを委託していたイセトーのランサムウェア被害により、同社が提供したデータが流出したと公表した。イセトーの最終報告を受けた調査で、氏名、会員番号、教室名などを含む会員739,714人と、住所やマスキングされた口座情報などを含む指導者17,481人の情報が流出したことが判明した。
